description: Ministry of Forests (MOF) Bridges and Major Culverts is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by Engineering Branch. Road Structures on Forest Service Roads (FSRs) includes bridges and major culverts (greater than or equal to 2m diameter). Information is recorded in the Corporate Bridge Register (CBR). Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Engineering Branch. Its tags are Bridge, Bridges, CBR, Corporate Bridge Register, Culvert. It offers 4 resource(s) in ARCGIS_REST, KML, MULTIPLE, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Access Only. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
